The aquatic '''Rebel Navy''' was the aquatic naval component of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Alliance Military/Legends|Alliance Military]]. They committed operations on aquatic worlds; with their most common enemy being the [[Imperial Maritime Division]].

==History==
In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the Rebel Navy took part in operations on the "breadbasket" [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Reytha]], along with the [[Alliance Starfighter Corps/Legends|Rebel Air Force]] and the [[Alliance Army/Legends|Alliance Army]]. The Rebel presence on Reytha was eradicated by a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Army/Legends|army]] led by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. The [[Navy/Legends|Navy]] operated a base on an [[Montrosa Islands]] island as well as [[Montrosa Ocean|ocean]] patrols until the end of the battle.

==Organization==
The aquatic Rebel Navy was part of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Alliance Military/Legends|Alliance Military]] and was supported by [[R2-D5]] [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droids]]. The Rebel Navy, similarly to the [[Imperial Maritime Division]], operated combat vehicles on the [[Water/Legends|water]], including [[Hunter (aquatic vehicle)|destroyers]], [[Scout (Rebel Alliance)|frigates]], [[Prowler|cruisers]], [[Javelin (vehicle)|anti-air destroyers]], and [[Transport Ship (Rebel Alliance)|transports]]. The vehicles were constructed at [[Shipyard (water)|shipyards]]. [[Utility trawler]]s gathered resources such as [[Fish/Legends|fish]] for the Navy.

==Behind the scenes==
The Rebel Navy appears in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''. There is a Rebel Navy base in one of the Darth Vader campaign missions which must be destroyed. The mission and therefore the Navy appears in the game's [[2002]] expansion pack, [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|''Clone Campaigns'']]. The vehicles used by the Rebel Navy may be constructed in multiplayer matches by Rebel Alliance players.

One of the staff members of ''Galactic Battleground''{{'s}} development team, [[Matthew Keast]], implied that the Rebel Alliance was at a disadvantage regarding sea-faring operations.
